lead: A `Core` class reached only through an `array<T>` return is held by no case that does not name it.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/corpus/mod.rs`'s `Attribution` follows a `CoreTy::Instance` return to the class it builds and stops there, so `$info->methods()` then `$row->name()` attributes nothing to `Core\Reflect\MethodInfo` and the floor of three fails over members the case plainly asks. Write the class's own name in, which a `foreach (… as Core\Reflect\MethodInfo $row)` binding already does.
